enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed on back. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Turns to right side. Bends knees. Straightens legs. Turns onto back. Remains still.
Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Wash face. Brush teeth. Turn off tap. Dry face. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Close cupboard. Prepare breakfast. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes. Put dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Organizing work bag and checking schedule on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open work bag. Take out items. Place items on bed. Pick up phone. Check schedule. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Place laptop in bag. Zip bag. Put bag by door.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community site
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs and doing administrative work at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleagues. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Schedule meetings. Attend meeting. Take notes. Talk to team members. Organize files. Prepare documents. Print documents. Review budget. Update calendar. Check voicemail. Send emails. Leave desk for lunch.
Walk to lunch area. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Clean up. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs and attending meetings at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Check email. Reply to urgent emails. Make phone calls. Prepare presentation. Attend meeting. Present slides. Answer questions. Take notes. Discuss program details. Coordinate with volunteers. Update program schedule. Send follow-up emails. Organize materials. File documents. Check calendar. Confirm appointments. Make to-do list. Leave office.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Close cupboard. Fill pot with water. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Cook dinner. Set table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Put dishes in sink. Wipe table. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Fill sink with water. Add soap. Pick up sponge. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place in dish rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place in dish rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in dish rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter. Put away dishes. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Check phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading or using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book down. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll. Type message. Send message. Lock phone. Put phone down. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to other side. Bends knees. Straightens legs. Turn onto back. Remain still.
